title: Good but …
text:
Initial reactions - it’ll due but needs logical feature upgrades. Like ones that don’t require me to do my own math. 

Downloaded a week ago. 

Upgraded to paid ad free version immediately. Why? You suddenly realize they sell your internet history when adds pop up under your bills for things that should not be popping up unprovoked.

Initial frustration:

No way to mark a bill as “partially paid” so it deducts what you did pay but still shows the balance as “unpaid.” Now, you can change the bill amount for that month but once you mark it paid, you have to make a new entry of a one month appearance only to add the balance. 

If you have past due bills, there is no master tally that includes past and current. You can SEE the past due bills with their own total (under “Due and Next Due) but then you have to do your own math to figure out how much money you need for all three sections (other two: “Due within 7 days” and “Due within 30 days”).  

And I need the app cuz … math.  So …

In the “Due and Next Due,” you should be able to toggle off the separation between the due 7 days and due in 30 days heading.

You should be able to set a date range: show me ALL unpaid bills (past and current) up until Jan. 1 or whatever.  Now, the 30 days keeps rolling and if you have a main number in your head for what you will get by the end of the month, the tally that includes next month’s bills is counterproductive cuz then … math. 

The calendar view has a split screen to show the calendar at the top with red highlights on the days bills are due. If you click on a day, the bills due for that day populate.

They should have the second half of the screen automatically populate with the entire month of bills, separated by date. Then you can just scroll them without clicking on each date. It’s time consuming. 

You prob should also be able to see how much money you need for the next week alone (either past due, current or both) but that goes back to the date range feature. 


In-app “Send Feedback” button doesn’t work. It also did not work from the “Rate Me” pop-up.

All that said, for $6, it’ll due.

title: Can’t download data
text:
I like this app. I’ve been using it for three or four years. But I’ve been begging for a way to download it to an or even a CSV file so I can prepare my taxes with this info.
Currently, there is no way to download it, and I basically have to retype this an Excel spreadsheet. Please please please make this downloadable to a CSV file or something.
